Chemistry 2011-II.question: One of the occupational health hazards commonly faced by the workers of ceramics, pottery and glass industry is
Chemistry 2011-II.explanation: (c)  Silicosis  is  a  chronic  lung  disease  caused  by breathing in silica dust. Silicosis (silico tuberculosis) occurs in workers whose occupation is related to pottery, ceramic, and glass industry.

Chemistry 2011-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2011-II.question: Sacrificial anode protects iron or ships, underground pipelines etc from rusting, a process known as cathodic protection. Which one of the following metals cannot be used as a sacrificial anode?
Chemistry 2011-II.explanation: (a)  The method of protection of iron from corrosion by using a more  reactive metal is known as sacrificial protection or cathodic protection.  Zinc, magnesium and aluminium metals are more reactive than iron hence, they are used as a sacrificial anode while tin is less reactive than iron hence, it cannot be used as a sacrificial anode.

Chemistry 2011-II.question: Statement I : Oxides of sulphur and nitrogen present in high concentration in air are dissolved in rain drops. Statement II : Oxyacids of sulphur and nitrogen make rain water acidic.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are individually true and Statement II is the correct explanation of Statement I
Both Statement I and Statement II are individually true but Statement II is NOT the correct explanation of Statement I
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Chemistry 2011-II.answer: Both Statement I and Statement II are individually true and Statement II is the correct explanation of Statement I
Chemistry 2011-II.explanation: (a)  Oxides of sulphur and nitrogen present in high concentration in air dissolve in rain drops and form oxyacids of sulphur and nitrogen.
